description: Fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967). Cleaner equivalent of exp456: each LUT module = base TinyMHLut (unchanged) + PARALLEL DominanceLinearBranch = VectorToDominance(x, hard +/-1 STE, full triu pairs) -> nn.Linear -> output, summed. Computes the same linear-on-pairwise-dominance-signs 'main effect' as exp456's NAP=1 tables, but as ONE matmul with DENSE gradients (near-zero sparsity noise) and the Linear trains on AdamW (base LUT stays on LION). Tests whether a clean low-noise main-effect speeds convergence. Deployable matmul-free via popcount on +/-1 bits. Non-LUT + branch on AdamW. Saves checkpoint.
